method: Re-fetch public market metadata and every bets page; reconstruct at each original archived cutoff, with filled/non-redemption/share filters and identical timestamp collapse. No current trades backfilled beyond cutoff.

repairs.reason: One additional qualifying pre-cutoff observation returned by the current source. No existing probability changed; origin of the historical omission is undetermined.

publicationPolicy: Only verified public-release dates permit comparison. Submission dates and conflicting dates are blocked; day-only timezone unknown excludes UTC±14h envelope. Differences are descriptive, never causal.

note: 已核对来源页面的日期；没有可靠的公开时刻与时区，比较排除日期在 UTC±14 小时下覆盖的全部时间。
The source date is checked. Without reliable publication time/zone, comparisons exclude the entire possible day across UTC±14 hours.

publicationNodes.interpretation: No causal attribution; factual technical context is separate from observed price differences.
